formulations.Polymer system Notes: High molecular weight (900 K) PEO supplied by Aldrich; dried under partial vacuum < 5 mm/Hg argon at 45°-50°C for ≈ 48h; salts recrystallized in acetonitrile and dried under partial vacuum for ≈ 48h at specified temperatures; films cast in acetonitrile (12-20% by vol) and dried under partial vacuum at 95°-100°C for a minimum of 48h; stored in glove box at 25°C; water content < 25 ppm
formulations.VFT Notes (above temp): Arrhenius type for temperatures below the transition temperature and VTF for higher values.
formulations.Arrhenius notes: The activation energy of ion transport is independent of the anion, and remains mainly constant at 0.7 eV over the concentration range studied for T > 60°C.
formulations.Notes: Water content negligible (< 25 ppm); salts recrystallized in acetonitrile
formulations.Reference: C. D. Robitaille and D. Fauteux, J. Electrochem. Soc., 133, 315 (1986)
